name: 10 CARD REGRETS POKER
description: 10 Card Regrets is a split-pot poker variant. 2-5 players. 52-card deck. Players build TWO open 5-card hands simultaneously: a Low hand and a High hand. Dealt 2 cards at a time, must assign each to Low or High (irrevocable). Cards revealed after assignment. 5 dealing rounds with betting between each. Pot split: best High hand + best Low hand.

A split-pot poker variant in which each player builds two five-card hands (low on the left, high on the right) with irrevocable assignment. Documented as a home or informal variant for two to five players; no specific inventor or region is given in the primary source.
Two to five players; each builds a low and a high five-card hand.
